implementation: ESC1/ESS1 kind17 maps authenticated PC resource authority to native selection/refresh/cancel/recovery. Independent random epoch and binding/grant/client metadata; periodic authoritative snapshot invalidates old scope. Exact latest operation replay and immutable nonce-keyed read snapshot, no filesystem I/O in handler. Native worker owns actual commit/render.

test_corrections.basis: Established SDC1 response puts CONFIG_READ bytes at24..39, also decoded by Android DeviceControlProtocol.kt copyOfRange(24,40). Initial new fixture incorrectly expected offset32.
External entropy macro discarded epoch argument and caused unused-variable compilation error. Corrected peer consumes arguments; this is not business Red.

new_red_green.failure: First default query attempted the installer binding path, which can request installer quiescence. The independent forbidden-domain observer asserted.
new_red_green.fix: Separate default-selection authority metadata/epoch. First query must leave unbound installer untouched. Actual product maintenance loop invalidates selection on grant change; old epoch rejected without undoing committed default.
new_red_green.limits: Installer functions are forbidden external-domain peers in this default-route fixture; separate real installer regressions retained.

integration.production: Real SDC1 staging, selection wire controller, native selection/volume/store/render. Product variant extracts product_pc_config and product_pc_pack_step verbatim.
integration.external: Mount/umount/framebuffer, entropy and authoritative grant source are controlled peers; unexercised installer domain fails if called by default route. TLS fixture separately executes actual PC guard and requires RESOURCES; SCENES/DIAGNOSTICS denied. TLS handler deliberately returns ENOTSUP, never fake save success.
integration.not_proven: No single PC CLI-to-TLS-to-native-default-to-screen end-to-end test yet. Phone binding/UI and PC client commands remain unimplemented. Host direct worker step is not RTOS scheduling or physical acceptance.
integration.snapshot_limit: Version/filename describes the latest native job outcome. Explicit refresh reads durable state; query alone does not reread changes from other callers.

validation.digest_limit: Runner production_digest covers tracked paths; new module/header additionally captured in explicit input hashes. No source edits during final run.
validation.AP: PASS incremental; all selection/recovery/request and protocol public symbols linked
